claims.text: Training and inference batches are constructed to leverage coreferent mentions by modeling mention coreference relationships across documents.
The approach includes building minimum spanning arborescences over mentions and entities to explicitly model coreference relationships.
The learned representations can be used for coreference of mentions across documents, indicating effective training and inference batch construction.
